Let's get Kipchoge's marathon world record time and marathon distance, and also check if he set a non-official record (like INEOS 1:59).
Wait, let's fetch details on Kipchoge's marathon record times from Wikipedia using curl in `run_command`.
```python
res = await run_command('curl -s -A "Mozilla/5.0" "https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eliud_Kipchoge" | grep -i -C 3 "world record"')
print(res[:2000])
```
